verdict.rationale: Factory supports reviewing diffs and merging from 'the App or your terminal' and offers cloud session sync so sessions are available 'from any browser,' plus tiered autonomy that gates operations requiring manual confirmation — together implying remote approval of agent actions. However, there is no explicit mention of a phone-optimized/mobile app or push-notification-driven approval flow. Missing for 10: dedicated mobile app or phone UI evidence, explicit approval/notification workflow for pending agent decisions, and independent confirmation of mobile usability.
